grants.words: PutObject on the one filled_report_values gold prefix. The existing single write statement keeps its sid and its list; the list gains the sixth prefix, built from the module's TABLE constant.
GetObject on the one served model-series object, bucket and key read from the adapter file constants. A new statement; no list is granted on the served bucket.

GetObject under the household_crosswalk prefix, and ListBucket on the firm gold bucket restricted by a StringLike condition on s3:prefix to that prefix only. Two new statements; no PutObject on the crosswalk.

expected_plan.words: The role policy changes because its policy document gains the three grants. The function changes because its code hash follows the bundle the applier builds at apply (built by 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~DB2); this cell edits no function code. These are the order's expected counts, inferred, not planned.

validated.words: This box has no terraform binary, so terraform fmt and validate did not run; they are the applier's. Checked instead: the issuer checker's HCL clauses on the working tree (criterion AC1), the additive line counts after commit (AC2), and an ASCII scan of both files.

derivations.served_series: The bucket and the key come from the SERVED_BUCKET and SERVED_KEY constants of model_series_windows.py, read by file() and regex() in locals.tf; neither value is typed in the Terraform.
derivations.crosswalk: The prefix mirrors FirmAdapter.crosswalk_address() and crosswalk_prefix() in filled_report_values.py (segments advi, firm, gold, household_crosswalk); its bucket is the firm gold bucket that the irpt tables use, as the naming-builder recount confirmed.
derivations.filled_prefix: The prefix is built from the module TABLE constant, mirrored as irpt_rg_gold_table_filled, joined to the firm and the irpt and gold segments exactly as the other gold prefixes are.

words: Three explicit grants added to the reporting-gold role as Terraform statements, each derived from the producers' constants or the naming builder. Nothing planned, applied or deployed; the plan and the apply are the applier's act under the signed pair.
